purpose: Separate action observability of real future latents from action-cycle fidelity of frozen LTWM counterfactual predictions, using no ATE/objective training signal.

lineage.withdrawn_hypothesis: Same-state hard-negative action-path adaptation alone learns useful counterfactual futures.

inputs: previous adapted DINOv3 patch latent at t-1
current adapted DINOv3 patch latent at t
actual or predicted adapted DINOv3 patch latent at t+4
inverse_probe.target: executed local SE(2) actions H1-H4, flattened to 12 dimensions

architecture.head: flatten 4x4x32, Linear 512 to 128, GELU, Dropout 0.1, Linear 128 to 12

inverse_probe.target_standardization: mean/std computed only from outer-train routes

training.route_fold_assignment: exact deterministic assignment shared with scand_union65_listwise_selector_v1 and the withdrawn hard-negative experiment
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step; outer routes and outcomes never select epoch or hyperparameters

real_future_observability: integrated four-step path RMSE in meters
route direction versus outer-train mean-action baseline
frozen_warm_forward_cycle: inverse-decoded candidate action versus input candidate action standardized RMSE
candidate ranking by distance between inverse(real goal latent) and inverse(predicted candidate future latent)
evaluation.fixed_direct_inverse_planner: choose physical/support union65 action nearest to inverse(real goal latent) in outer-train standardized 12D action space; formal-v70 retained

branch_rule.if_observability_and_relevance_pass_but_: Proceed once to frozen-inverse action-cycle LTWM training. The inverse probe remains frozen and ATE/objective gradients remain forbidden.
branch_rule.if_forward_inverse_already_passes: Freeze the action-observable latent metric; no LTWM retraining is needed before the RECON latent guard.
branch_rule.if_real_future_observability_fails: Stop current DINOv3 latent/action representation research; behavior-only LTWM tuning cannot recover information absent from the target representation.
branch_rule.if_observability_passes_but_relevance_fa: Stop action-observable cycle branch because the physical signal is not aligned with the user's held-route ATE objective.
